question: What internal order source and eligibility criteria should replace the Mercado Libre browser view for this daily Segmail label email?
rationale: The code has the building blocks, but the browser source was rejected and the replacement business criteria are not specified in the issue or current docs.

options.title: Use internal order data
options.body: Implement the automation only after operations defines the internal statuses, date window, and cancellation exclusion for eligible Mercado Libre orders.

options.title: Keep blocked
options.body: Leave the issue blocked until Mercado Libre or operations provides a reliable non-browser source for the daily list.

options.title: Sponsor browser automation
options.body: Explicitly accept the maintenance risk of browser/profile automation for the current manual flow.

recommendation.title: Use internal order data
recommendation.body: Implement the automation only after operations defines the internal statuses, date window, and cancellation exclusion for eligible Mercado Libre orders.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn already pushed back on browser automation in the discussion and has recent Meli/FedEx implementation history.
